name: Chibu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Chibu village emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing stylised characters.
history: Municipal flag of Chibu, a village in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in March 1966.

features.role: Chibu village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing stylised characters
